property.android:value: MacroDroid is a comprehensive device automation app that can automate a wide range of user configured tasks on a device. In order to listen for triggers and keep long running tasks alive in the background it is essential that MacroDroid can run reliably as a foreground service. Because MacroDroid has a very wide range of features it doesn't fit into any single category of foreground services but instead it encompasses the full spectrum of features that an app may use based on whatever the user configures.
